newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index marginally firmer.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index marginally firmer.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index rose 0.12 points or 0.17 percent to 69.72 points on Monday with most of the Indian markets closed for Diwali holidays.
The National Stock Exchange 50-share index, the only market open, finished 14.67 points up at 894.67. The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-index had ended on Sunday 13.60 points higher at 3,080.26.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 13.82 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
